table.retrieve:
SELECT
	RowGroup=0, 
	ItemType='PATIENT ADMISSION RECEIPT',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=PA.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=V.DocumentCode, 
	TransType = LTRIM(RTRIM(V.DocumentType)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(STR(V.DocumentCode, 10))), 
	Date = V.Date, 
	Details = V.Remarks,
	Cash = 'N',
	V.CheckNo,
	Vrow=V.Vrow,
	Qty=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit=V.Debit,
	Credit=V.Credit,
	Others= 0,
	Demand=NULL
FROM
	VirtualGL V,
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA
WHERE   
	PA.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_admissioncode) AND
	PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	V.DocumentType = 'PA' AND
	V.DocumentCode = PA.AdmissionCode AND
	V.Credit > 0 AND
	V.Date >= PA.Date AND
	V.Date <= CASE PA.Discharged WHEN 'N' THEN GETDATE() ELSE PA.DischargedOn END
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	RowGroup=1,
	ItemType='MEDICINE',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,  
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	TransType='SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
	Date = S.Date, 
	Details = I.Name,
	Cash = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.RowID),
	Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty),
	ItemValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
				(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
				(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
				(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
		SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.RowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.ROWID) 
		FROM SaleDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	Demand=MAX(D.SaleItemDescription)
FROM 
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA,
	Item I,
	SaleLedger S,	 
	SaleDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		SS.SaleInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0) -
		(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
		SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc),
		InvSaleTax=	ROUND((SUM((DD.looseqty * 
			(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
			SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2),
		NetAmt=ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * 
				(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty*(DD.saleprice - DD.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0)
	FROM SaleLedger SS, SaleDetail DD 
	WHERE 
		SS.SaleInvCode = DD.SaleInvCode AND
		SS.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_admissioncode)
	GROUP BY
		SS.SaleInvCode,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.FlatDisc,
		SS.InvGSTPerc1,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.MiscCharges,
		SS.SalesTax) T
WHERE
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) and  
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) and  
	( S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode ) and
	( S.SaleInvCode = T.SaleInvCode ) and
	( D.ICode = I.Icode )
GROUP  BY
	P.RegNo,
	P.Name,
	S.AdmissionCode,
	PA.Date,
	PA.UserCode,
	PA.DischargedOn,
	PA.DischargedBy,
	PA.Discharged,
	PA.LocationCode,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.Date,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	S.SaleCatCode,
	S.HeaderInvNo,
	S.HeaderNo,
	S.CustCode, 
	S.Date,
	S.DiscPerc,
	S.MiscCharges,
	S.SalesTax,
	S.FlatDisc,
	S.InvGstPerc1,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	RowGroup=2,
	ItemType='MEDICINE',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=S.SaleInvCode,
	TransType='SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
	Date = CASE WHEN S.AmtDate IS NULL THEN S.Date ELSE S.AmtDate END, 
	Details = 'Amt. Recvd. During Sale #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SaleInvCode))),
	Cash = CASE S.SaleCatCode WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	CheckNo=S.AmtReference,
	VRow=9999999,
	Qty=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = 0,
	Credit= isnull(S.Amt, 0) + isnull(S.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode=S.SaleInvCode), 0),
	Others= 0,
	Demand=SPACE(100)
FROM
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA,
	SaleLedger S
WHERE   
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) and  
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) and  
	( S.SaleCatcode = 2 ) AND
	( S.Amt <> 0 OR S.CashCharged <> 0 OR S.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT CW.SaleInvCode FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode))
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	RowGroup=3,
	ItemType='MEDICINE',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=S.SRInvCode,
	TransType='SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SRInvCode))),
	Date = S.Date, 
	Details = I.Name,
	Cash = CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 7 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.SRUTN),
	Qty=-SUM(D.LooseQty),
	ItemValue= -1 * (SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * .01 * D.discperc) +
				(D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * S.discperc))) + 
		SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty * D.SRPrice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01))),
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) FROM SRDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 7 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) FROM SRDetail SD WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.SRUTN) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SRUTN) 
		FROM SRDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.SRInvCode=S.SRInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	Demand=MAX(D.ReturnItemDescription)
FROM
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA,
	Item I,
	SRLedger S,
	SRDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		SS.SRInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0) -
		(SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *

				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
		SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc)),
		InvSaleTax=	ROUND((SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
			SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2),
		NetAmt=ROUND(
		SUM( (DD.looseqty + DD.bonusqty) * DD.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM(ROUND( (DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc)) * DD.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND( (SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
				(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) -
				SS.flatdisc) * (SS.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) + 
		Round(SUM((DD.looseqty * DD.SRPrice) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges + SS.salestax - SS.flatdisc, 0)
	FROM SRLedger SS, SRDetail DD 
	WHERE 
		SS.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_Admissioncode) AND
		SS.SRInvCode = DD.SRInvCode
	GROUP BY
		SS.SRInvCode,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.FlatDisc,
		SS.InvGSTPerc1,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.MiscCharges,
		SS.SalesTax) T
WHERE   
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) and  
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) and  
	( S.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode ) and
	( S.SRInvCode = T.SRInvCode ) and
	( D.ICode = I.Icode )
GROUP BY 
	P.RegNo,
	P.Name,
	S.AdmissionCode,
	PA.Date,
	PA.UserCode,
	PA.DischargedOn,
	PA.DischargedBy,
	PA.Discharged,
	PA.LocationCode,
	S.SRInvCode,
	S.Date,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	S.SRCatCode,
	S.HeaderInvNo,
	S.HeaderNo,
	S.CustCode, 
	S.Date,
	S.DiscPerc,
	S.MiscCharges,
	S.SalesTax,
	S.FlatDisc,
	S.InvGstPerc1,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	RowGroup=4,
	ItemType='MEDICINE',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=S.SRInvCode,
	TransType='SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SRInvCode))),
	Date = CASE WHEN S.AmtDate IS NULL THEN S.Date ELSE S.AmtDate END, 
	Details = 'Cash Paid During S/Return #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.SRInvCode))),
	Cash = CASE S.SRCatCode WHEN 7 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	CheckNo=S.AmtReference,
	VRow=9999999,
	Qty=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = ISNULL(S.Amt, 0) + isnull(S.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentType = 'SR' AND CW.DocumentCode=S.SRInvCode), 0),
	Credit= 0,
	Others= 0,
	Demand=SPACE(100)
FROM
	Patient P, PatientAdmission PA, SRLedger S
WHERE   
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) and  
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) and  
	( S.SRCatCode = 7 ) AND
	( S.Amt <> 0 OR S.CashCharged <> 0 OR S.SRInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT CW.DocumentCode FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentType = 'SR' AND CW.DocumentCode = S.SRInvCode))
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	RowGroup=5,
	ItemType='SERVICES',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=S.ServiceInvCode,
	TransType='RS-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.ServiceInvCode))),
	Date=S.Date,
	Details=SV.Name,
	Cash = CASE S.ServiceCatCode WHEN 11 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.SrvRowID),
	Qty=SUM(D.Qty),
	ItemValue=SUM(D.Qty * (D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (1-(.01*S.discperc))),
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.SrvROWID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SrvROWID) 
		FROM ServiceDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ServiceInvCode=S.ServiceInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.SrvRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SrvROWID) 
		FROM ServiceDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ServiceInvCode=S.ServiceInvCode) THEN CASE S.ServiceCatCode WHEN 11 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.SrvRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SrvROWID) 
		FROM ServiceDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ServiceInvCode=S.ServiceInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	Demand=SPACE(100)
FROM 
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA,
	Servicedetail D,
	ServiceHeader S,
	Service SV,
	(SELECT 
		SS.ServiceInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(SUM(DD.qty * (DD.Price - DD.ServiceFlatDisc)  * (1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges - SS.flatdisc, 0) -
		(SUM((DD.qty * (DD.Price - DD.ServiceFlatDisc) ) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges - SS.flatdisc),
		InvSaleTax=	0,
		NetAmt=ROUND(SUM(DD.qty * (DD.Price - DD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges - SS.flatdisc, 0)
	FROM ServiceHeader SS, ServiceDetail DD 
	WHERE 
		SS.ServiceInvCode = DD.ServiceInvCode AND
		SS.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_admissioncode)
	GROUP BY
		SS.ServiceInvCode,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.FlatDisc,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.MiscCharges) T
WHERE
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) and  
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) and  
	( S.ServiceInvCode = D.ServiceInvCode ) and
	( S.ServiceInvCode = T.ServiceInvCode ) AND
	( D.ServiceCode = SV.Servicecode )
GROUP  BY
	P.RegNo,
	P.Name,
	S.AdmissionCode,
	PA.Date,
	PA.UserCode,
	PA.DischargedOn,
	PA.DischargedBy,
	PA.Discharged,
	PA.LocationCode,
	S.ServiceInvCode,
	S.Date,
	SV.Name,
	S.ServiceCatCode,
	S.HeaderNo,
	S.CustCode, 
	S.Date,
	S.DiscPerc,
	S.MiscCharges,
	S.FlatDisc,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL

	RowGroup=5,
	ItemType='SERVICES',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,

	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,

	TransCode=S.ServiceInvCode,

	Details = 'Amt. Recvd. During Service Inv. #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.ServiceInvCode))),
	Cash = CASE S.ServiceCatCode WHEN 11 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=9999999,
	Qty=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = 0,
	Credit= isnull(S.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentType = 'RS' AND CW.DocumentCode=S.ServiceInvCode), 0),
	Others= 0,
	Demand=SPACE(100)
FROM
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA,
	ServiceHeader S
WHERE   
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) and  
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) and  
	( S.ServiceCatcode = 11 ) AND
	( S.CashCharged <> 0 OR S.ServiceInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT CW.DocumentCode FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentType = 'RS' AND CW.DocumentCode = S.ServiceInvCode))
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	RowGroup=6,
	ItemType='SERVICES',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=S.ServiceRInvCode,
	TransType='RR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.ServiceRInvCode))),
	Date=S.Date,
	Details=SV.Name,
	Cash = CASE S.ServiceRCatCode WHEN 14 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.SrvRRowID),
	Qty= - SUM(D.Qty),
	ItemValue=-1 * SUM(D.Qty * (D.ServicePrice - D.ServiceFlatDisc)  * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (1-(.01*S.discperc))),
	NetAmt= T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.SrvRRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SrvRRowID) 
		FROM ServiceRDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ServiceRInvCode=S.ServiceRInvCode) THEN CASE S.ServiceRCatCode WHEN 14 THEN 0 ELSE T.NetAmt END ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.SrvRRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SrvRRowID) 
		FROM ServiceRDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ServiceRInvCode=S.ServiceRInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.SrvRRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(SD.SrvRROWID) 
		FROM ServiceRDetail SD 
		WHERE SD.ServiceRInvCode=S.ServiceRInvCode) THEN ISNULL(S.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(S.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvSaleTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	Demand=SPACE(100)
FROM 
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA,
	ServiceRdetail D,
	ServiceRHeader S,
	Service SV,
	(SELECT 
		SS.ServiceRInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(SUM(DD.qty * (DD.serviceprice - DD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges - SS.flatdisc, 0) -
		(SUM((DD.qty * (DD.serviceprice - DD.ServiceFlatDisc) ) *
			(1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges - SS.flatdisc),
		InvSaleTax=	0,
		NetAmt=ROUND(SUM(DD.qty * (DD.serviceprice - DD.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - (.01 * DD.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * SS.discperc)) + 
			SS.misccharges - SS.flatdisc, 0)
	FROM ServiceRHeader SS, ServiceRDetail DD 
	WHERE 
		SS.ServiceRInvCode = DD.ServiceRInvCode AND
		SS.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_admissioncode)
	GROUP BY
		SS.ServiceRInvCode,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.FlatDisc,
		SS.DiscPerc,
		SS.MiscCharges) T

WHERE
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) and  
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) and  
	( S.ServiceRInvCode = D.ServiceRInvCode ) and
	( S.ServiceRInvCode = T.ServiceRInvCode ) AND
	( D.ServiceCode = SV.Servicecode )
GROUP  BY
	P.RegNo,
	P.Name,
	S.AdmissionCode,
	PA.Date,
	PA.UserCode,
	PA.DischargedOn,
	PA.DischargedBy,
	PA.Discharged,
	PA.LocationCode,
	S.ServiceRInvCode,
	S.Date,
	SV.Name,
	S.ServiceRCatCode,
	S.HeaderNo,
	S.CustCode, 
	S.Date,
	S.DiscPerc,
	S.MiscCharges,
	S.FlatDisc,
	T.InvSaleTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	RowGroup=6,
	ItemType='SERVICES',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=S.ServiceRInvCode,
	TransType='RR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.ServiceRInvCode))),
	Date = S.Date, 
	Details = 'Amt. Paid During Service Ret. Inv. #:' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), S.ServiceRInvCode))),
	Cash = CASE S.ServiceRCatCode WHEN 14 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END,
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=9999999,
	Qty=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit = isnull(S.CashCharged, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentType = 'RR' AND CW.DocumentCode=S.ServiceRInvCode), 0),
	Credit= 0,
	Others= 0,
	Demand=SPACE(100)
FROM
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA,
	ServiceRHeader S
WHERE   
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) and  
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) and  
	( S.ServiceRCatcode = 14 ) AND
	( S.CashCharged <> 0 OR S.ServiceRInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT CW.DocumentCode FROM MasterCashWin CW WHERE CW.DocumentType = 'RR' AND CW.DocumentCode = S.ServiceRInvCode))
UNION ALL
SELECT
	RowGroup=9,
	ItemType='PAYMENT/RECEIPT',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=PA.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=GL.GLVochCode, 
	TransType = RTRIM(LTRIM(VC.ShortName)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), GL.GLVochCode))), 
	Date = GL.Date, 
	Details = GD.Remarks,
	Cash = 'N',
	GD.ChkNo,
	Vrow=GD.GLROWID,
	Qty=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit=GD.Debit,
	Credit=GD.Credit,
	Others= 0,
	Demand=SPACE(100)
FROM
	VocherCategory VC,
	GLHeader GL,
	GLDetail GD,
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA
WHERE   
	PA.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_admissioncode) AND
	PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	GL.Posted = 'Y' AND
	GL.GlVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND
	GL.VochCatCode = VC.VochCatCode AND
	GD.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	GD.AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode=3) AND
	GL.Date >= PA.Date AND
	GL.Date <= CASE PA.Discharged WHEN 'N' THEN GETDATE() ELSE PA.DischargedOn END
UNION ALL
SELECT
	RowGroup=9,
	ItemType='PAYMENT/RECEIPT',
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=PA.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation = (SELECT L.Name FROM PatientLocation L WHERE L.LocationCode = PA.LocationCode),
	TransCode=TH.DocumentCode, 
	TransType = RTRIM(LTRIM(TT.ShortName)) + '-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), TH.TransactionCode))), 
	Date = TH.Date, 
	Details = 'Amount ' + CASE TT.TransactionCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Receipt' ELSE 'Paid' END + ' During Transaction Document: ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), TH.DocumentCode))),
	Cash = 'N',
	ChkNo=SPACE(100),
	Vrow=0,
	Qty=0,
	ItemValue=0,
	NetAmt=0,
	Debit=
		CASE TT.TransactionCatCode 
		WHEN 1 THEN 0 
		ELSE ISNULL(TH.CashCharged,0) 
		END + 
	SUM(
		CASE TT.TransactionCatCode 
		WHEN 1 THEN 0 
		ELSE ISNULL(TD.Amount,0)
		END),
	Credit= 
		CASE TT.TransactionCatCode 
		WHEN 1 THEN ISNULL(TH.CashCharged,0) 
		ELSE 0
		END + 
		SUM(
		CASE TT.TransactionCatCode 
		WHEN 1 THEN ISNULL(TD.Amount,0)
		ELSE 0
		END),
	Others= 0,
	Demand=SPACE(100)
FROM
	TransactionType TT,
	TransactionHeader TH
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
		(SELECT TransactionDetail.* 
		FROM TransactionDetail, TransactionHeader, PatientAdmission
		WHERE 
			PatientAdmission.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_admissioncode) AND
			PatientAdmission.PatientCode = TransactionHeader.PatientCode AND
			TransactionHeader.Posted = 'Y' AND
			TransactionHeader.DocumentCode = TransactionDetail.DocumentCode AND
			TransactionDetail.Amount <> 0 ) AS TD ON (TH.DocumentCode = TD.DocumentCode),
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA
WHERE   
	PA.AdmissionCode IN (:ai_admissioncode) AND
	PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	TH.Posted = 'Y' AND
	TH.TransactionTypeCode = TT.TransactionTypeCode AND
	TH.PatientCode = P.PatientCode AND
	TH.AccCode IN (SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SubCode=3) AND
	TH.Date >= PA.Date AND
	TH.Date <= CASE PA.Discharged WHEN 'N' THEN GETDATE() ELSE PA.DischargedOn END
GROUP BY
	TH.DocumentCode, 
	TT.ShortName, 
	TH.TransactionCode,
	TT.TransactionCatCode,
	TH.CashCharged,
	TH.Date, 
	P.RegNo,
	P.Name,
	PA.AdmissionCode,
	PA.Date,
	PA.UserCode,
	PA.DischargedOn,
	PA.DischargedBy,
	PA.Discharged,
	PA.LocationCode
ORDER BY
	RowGroup,
	ItemType,
	RegNo,
	Patient,
	Date,
	TransType,
	TransCode,
	VRow
table.sort: regno A, patient A, date A, transtype A, vrow A
